confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rest on several 2026 Penang sources (Numbeo, CityCost, LifeIndexed, menus and guides), but many are crowdsourced or undated, so treat them as bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine are weaker: cocktail uses 2026 guide ranges, and wine uses one undated house-wine figure plus local beer relationships. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or current rates. Ringgit-to-USD conversion assumes about RM4.2 per USD; no MYR rate was sourced. The FX value is the latest RBA observation I found (18 Nov 2026). The 19 Nov 2026 observation may not yet be published. I saw the value through a third-party summary that attributes it to the RBA, and I did not verify it on the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close comparable city needed. Food and drink anchors are based on Penang (George Town) 2026 price sources, with beer and cocktail relationships used where direct wine data was thin. Accommodation tiers come from general knowledge of George Town hostel and hotel pricing.
